Every lesson requires a semantic table and keyboard path. The 3D scene is optional; failure of WebGL or WebR must not remove the evidence table, R source, Quarto source, or precompiled Evidence IR.

Receipts are learner-controlled JSON. Version 2 can contain orientation state, prediction, selected observation and evidence IDs, explanation criteria, repair and transfer work, artifact hash, and local-only consent metadata. No telemetry is sent by the package.

Automated accessibility tests detect structural regressions. They do not replace keyboard-only walkthroughs, 200% zoom checks, reduced-motion checks, or review with an actual screen reader.
